conviction_note: Nothing unpriced decides this print. The scheduled date held with no Ad-hoc, against the 2025 precedent when a guidance cut was pre-released two weeks early, so the left tail is thinner. That is offset by a sourced free-cash-flow gap: H1 FCFE was EUR 64.6m against EUR 190-210m stated for FY26, and Q3 is the seasonally weak cash quarter. The revenue consensus of about EUR 197m looks stale and is disputed, but this name rose 9.3% through a Q2 revenue miss. So the findings sum to -0.5 while p_up sits at 51 on a 6.5% unsigned move. The two measurements nearly agree, and both are close to zero.

findings.finding: TeamViewer has filed no Ad-hoc before this Q3 print. In 2025 it pre-released a Q3 guidance cut by Ad-hoc on 21 Oct 2025, two weeks before the scheduled 4 Nov date. The absence on the eve of a 3 Nov release that it kept to schedule lowers the odds of a material FY26 revenue-guidance cut.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Guidance cut, Q3 2025 Ad-hoc: -21.6% (22 Oct 2025). FY26 guide set at 0-3% vs a 2-6% preliminary view: -6.3% (10 Feb 2026). Guidance reaffirmed: +5.7% (6 May 2026) and +9.3% (28 Jul 2026).
findings.original_quote: Anlässlich der heutigen Mitteilung wird TeamViewer die vollständigen Ergebnisse für das dritte Quartal und die ersten neun Monate 2025 in unmittelbarem Anschluss an diese Veröffentlichung publizieren. findings.why_not_priced: The absence is public, but it is an inference rather than a number. The 5-day run-up of -6.9% into the print suggests some cut risk is still being priced. If the market had fully absorbed it, the stock would not have sold off in the last week on no news.

findings.finding: H1 2026 levered FCFE was EUR 64.6m (Q1 23.8, Q2 40.8), against EUR 104.1m in H1 2025 and an FY26 statement of EUR 190-210m. H2 therefore needs EUR 125-145m against EUR 104.3m in H2 2025, while Q3 is the seasonally weak cash quarter (Q3 2025: EUR 21.1m) and Q2 had fewer upfront multi-year deals. A weak Q3 FCF or a trimmed cash statement is the likeliest disappointment.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Q2 2026 FCFE -31%: opened -8.4%, closed +9.3%, then fell -12.0% on 30 Jul as JPMorgan cut its target and a BaFin fine was reported. The cash line has not been isolated as the cause of any move.
findings.why_not_priced: The FY FCF range was given only verbally on the Q1 call. It is absent from the written guidance sections of the Q1 and Q2 releases and from the Quartr Q2 summary, so wire previews do not carry it. If it were priced, previews would flag the H2 cash ramp the way they flag the H2 revenue ramp, and none found does.
findings.independence: The FY range comes from the CFO on the Q1 call (https://financialfilings.com/filings/teamviewer-ag/call-transcript/2026/48453669/, 2026-05-06). The 2025 quarterly FCFE comes from the Q3 2025 and FY2025 releases. All are issuer documents, so not independent of the company.

The company's own path needs only about +0.9% cc in H2 for the low end of its guide, so a headline revenue miss against that number is likely.

language_note: The German Q3 2025 Ad-hoc text (boerse-online) carried the explicit statement that the full Q3 results were being pulled forward. It also referred to a 2027-2029 outlook to come with the FY results, which grounds the 'no Ad-hoc this year' inference. The English wires carried only the guidance cut itself.

German retail and finance sites (finanzen.net, goldesel, Börse Express) carried the dated analyst-note history: DZ Bank Kaufen 02.10.26, JPMorgan target 7.30 on 30.07.26, Goldman Neutral 08.09.26. The English searches did not surface it.
